title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-zvp7: duplicate definitions break lichen-oscore test compilation
description:
## Duplicate definitions

The commit introduces multiple duplicate definitions that prevent `cargo test -p lichen-oscore --no-run` from compiling. There are 50+ errors.

### Duplicates in `rust/lichen-oscore/tests/vectors.rs`
- `context_at` defined twice (lines 105 and 126) — identical signature/body
- `test_request_protection_vectors` defined twice (lines 175 and 430) — two different implementations, both named `#[test]`
- `test_response_protection_vectors` defined twice (lines 225 and 492) — two different implementations, both named `#[test]`

### Duplicates in `rust/lichen-oscore/src/lib.rs` test module  
- `TestStore` defined twice (lines 2088 and 2196)
- `TestProtect` trait defined twice (lines 2126 and 2234)
- Conflicting `impl SenderStateStore for TestStore` and `impl TestProtect for Context`

### API mismatch in first `test_request_protection_vectors` (line 188)
- Line 188: `Context::new(&master_secret, master_salt.as_deref(), None, &sender_id, &recipient_id)` — passes 5 args including `None` for id_context, but `Context::new` takes 4 args (id_context removed from signature)
- Calls `ctx.protect_request(pt.code, &options, &payload)` (line 205) but Context no longer has a `protect_request` method — the API moved to the `reserve_sender(&mut store)` pattern

### Other errors from duplicate pollution
- `Context::load_existing` referenced but not defined on Context
- Mismatched types from shadowing

### Root cause
The changes introduced two versions of each test — an old one using the removed `Context::new` + `protect_request` API and a new one using `context_at` + `reserve_sender`. The old versions need full removal, and the remaining code consolidated to a single, compiling version.
